text: Planning is done across the last three videos. This is the first lesson where Terraform and the Azure CLI actually run against a real subscription.
Bicep deploys the foundation first -- the resource group and storage account. Terraform then stands up the Databricks workspace and the Fabric capacity on top of it.
az deployment group create brings up fernbridgedlsprod with its bronze, silver, and gold containers, exactly as planned on the whiteboard two videos ago.
terraform apply stands up dbw-fernbridge-prod, attaches the Unity Catalog metastore, and creates the fernbridge catalog -- verified empty, which is exactly correct this early.
The infrastructure is live. Next: landing the first real Kafka events into the Bronze layer.
